uso.pres: Right now, habits, general truths — and casual near-future: «mañana trabajo».
uso.pret: DID: completed events at a specific time; each one moves the story forward. «Ayer comí paella, llegué a las dos.»
uso.imp: WAS DOING / USED TO: background, descriptions, weather, age, ongoing states, repeated habits. «Era tarde, llovía, siempre íbamos a la playa.»
uso.fut: WILL — plus guessing about the present: «Serán las tres» = it must be around 3.
uso.cond: WOULD — plus politeness («¿Podrías...?», «Me gustaría...») and guessing about the past: «Serían las tres».
uso.subj: After triggers, almost always with QUE: want/hope/doubt/emotion/impersonal + que, para que, cuando (future), ojalá. «Quiero que VENGAS.»
uso.subimp: Hypotheticals and past-tense triggers: «Si TUVIERA dinero, viajaría» · «Quería que VINIERAS».

verbos.nota: SER = what something IS: identity, origin, profession, time, personality. See Ser vs Estar.
ESTAR = how/where: states, moods, location, estar + -ando (progressive).
he comido = I have eaten. hay = there is/are · había = there was.
tener que + inf = have to · tener hambre/sueño/razón/años = be hungry/sleepy/right/X years old
él hizo (c→z) · hace calor = it's hot · hace dos años = two years ago
voy a + inf = going to (your everyday future). Preterite identical to SER!
pude = I managed to · podía = I could (in general) · ¿podrías...? = could you?
a ver... = let's see · nos vemos = see you
dar un paseo = take a walk · me da igual = I don't mind
saber vs conocer! supe = I found out
quisiera = I'd like (very polite) · no quiso = he refused
ponerse = put on / become: se puso rojo
salir DE casa · salir CON = to date
me cae bien = I like him/her (person vibes)
anduve: irregular preterite even natives flub
pedir needs no 'for'! preguntar = ask a question
me parece que = I think · ¿qué te parece?
Everyday Spain verb (coger el metro) — careful in Latin America!

quedamos a las 8 · me queda bien = it fits
